text_blocks.snippet: Losartan is a common blood pressure medication (an ARB) that is generally well-tolerated, though it can cause side effects.
These effects are usually mild and often improve over time as your body adjusts:

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness (especially when standing up quickly)
Cold-like symptoms (stuffy nose, runny nose, or upper respiratory tract infections)
Dry cough (less common than with ACE inhibitors, but still possible)

text_blocks.snippet: Contact a doctor or seek urgent medical care if you experience any of the following:

list.snippet: Allergic reactions / Angioedema: Sudden swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, or trouble breathing.
High potassium levels (hyperkalemia): Muscle weakness, slow, fast, or irregular heartbeat, or feeling confused.
Kidney problems: Decreased amount of urine, blood in the urine, or swelling in your ankles, hands, or feet.
Severely low blood pressure: Extreme dizziness, lightheadedness, or fainting.
Liver problems: Yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice) or severe stomach pain.
